name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Ink label docked to the focus ring of its trigger, with an optional shortcut cell. Never cut.
whenToUse: Use it to name what a control does, with its shortcut, on hover and focus. Never put the only copy of needed information in it; for a link preview use Hover card.

parts.name: Tooltip
parts.description: The usual tooltip, built from the parts: it names or explains its trigger; it never holds the only copy of information needed to act.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. Must be a focusable element that accepts a ref (a Button, a link, an icon button).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut shown in its own cell, e.g. "⌘K".

parts.name: TooltipPopup
parts.description: The label: Base UI's Portal, Positioner and Popup in one part, with the positioner's placement props lifted. An ink label docked to the trigger's FOCUS RING, not its box: the gap equals the ring (2px + 2px offset), so keyboard and pointer show the same geometry. Never cut, never a surface of its own. It carries the configuration of the place it is written.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut shown in its own cell, e.g. "⌘K".

parts.name: TooltipTrigger
parts.description: The element the tooltip names. Rendered as another part (`render={<Button />}`), the element is that part's and carries its data-slot.
